$comment: The church's building campaign (docs/pledges.md, decisions 97 to 105). Its dates count back from install day, so every install is the same distance into the campaign. The fund itself is in accounts.json.
name: Built on the Rock
description: Built on the Rock is our two-year campaign to build a Student Center at the Phoenix campus and add kids rooms at every campus. Like the wise builder in Matthew 7, we want to build on a foundation that lasts.
$lineFactors: Each pledge with a frequency gives a campaign line on the giver's usual gifts. The line is the pace that pays the pledge on the campaign's last day, times this factor. A stopped pledge gives on pace until it stops.
$generated: How generated households and businesses take part (decisions 101 to 105). The loader picks pledgers to reach the profile's giving.pctUnitsWithPledge, weighting each giving unit: steady rhythmic givers with steadyYears at the church, other rhythmic givers, other givers, and businesses. Mixes are weights. A rhythmic giver's pledge 'same' frequency is their giving rhythm.

pledgeEntry.$comment: Rock's two pages with a Pledge Entry block: (Public) Create Pledge in Rock RMS, and Pledge under Give on the external website. Rock ships the WebForms block, and a Rock job later swaps it for the Obsidian block with a new block Guid, so the loader finds the block on each page by either block type.
